name: Registration
description: End‑to‑end compliance and licence procurement for new and existing businesses.

subServices.name: GST Registration
subServices.data: Obtain a GSTIN and enable your business to legally collect and remit Goods & Services Tax across India.

subServices.name: GST Amendments
subServices.data: Update core or non‑core fields (address, directors, phone, etc.) in an existing GST registration without penalties.

subServices.name: GST Cancellation
subServices.data: Close a GST account for discontinued, merged, or turnover‑exempt businesses and receive final clearance.

subServices.name: Factory Licence Registration
subServices.data: Secure approval under the Factories Act, 1948 for premises involved in manufacturing processes.

subServices.name: Labour Licence Registration (Contractor & Principle Employer)
subServices.data: Register contractors and principal employers under the CLRA Act to employ contract labour legally.

subServices.name: PF Registration
subServices.data: Enroll establishments with 20+ employees under the EPF & MP Act for provident‑fund compliance.

subServices.name: ESIC Registration
subServices.data: Register organisations with 10+ employees for Employee State Insurance to provide medical benefits.

subServices.name: ESIC & PF Registration
subServices.data: Bundled service that simultaneously registers your entity under both EPFO and ESIC portals.

subServices.name: MLWF Registration
subServices.data: Get covered under the Maharashtra Labour Welfare Fund for mandatory periodic contributions.

subServices.name: Udyam Registration
subServices.data: Obtain an MSME/Udyam certificate for availing government incentives, subsidies and bank credit schemes.

subServices.name: PTEC Registration

subServices.name: PTRC Registration
subServices.data: Obtain Professional Tax Registration Certificate for employers to deduct and remit PT for employees.

subServices.name: Food License
subServices.data: Acquire FSSAI (FoSCoS) licence for food manufacturing, storage, distribution or retail operations.

subServices.name: Import Export Registration
subServices.data: Get an IEC (Import Export Code) from DGFT to legally import or export goods and services.

subServices.name: Shop & Establishment Registration
subServices.data: Register commercial establishments under the local S&E Act for operating licences and labour compliance.

subServices.name: MPCB Registration
subServices.data: Secure consents (Consent to Establish / Operate) from the Maharashtra Pollution Control Board.

subServices.name: Udyam Amendments
subServices.data: Modify enterprise details (plant, activity, investment, etc.) in an existing Udyam MSME certificate.

subServices.name: Trademark/ Copy Right Registration
subServices.data: File and protect brand names, logos, slogans or creative works under TM and Copyright laws.

subServices.name: Partnership Firm Registration
subServices.data: Draft partnership deed and register the firm with Registrar of Firms for legal recognition.

subServices.name: Startup Registration
subServices.data: Register under DPIIT’s Startup India program to claim tax holidays, IPR benefits and funding support.

subServices.name: HUF Registration
subServices.data: Set up a Hindu Undivided Family entity and obtain PAN for availing separate tax slab benefits.

subServices.name: Private Company Registration
subServices.data: Incorporate a private limited company with name approval, DIN, PAN, TAN and MCA filings.

subServices.name: LLP Registration
subServices.data: Form a Limited Liability Partnership with DSC, DPIN and LLP Agreement filing on MCA portal.

subServices.name: PAN Application
subServices.data: Apply for a Permanent Account Number (49A/49AA) for individuals, firms or foreign entities.

subServices.name: TAN Application
subServices.data: Obtain Tax Deduction & Collection Account Number to comply with TDS/TCS provisions.

subServices.name: DSC [Class 3 – 2 Years Validity]
subServices.data: Issue Class‑3 Digital Signature Certificate (USB token) valid for two years for MCA, GST and e‑tendering.

name: Taxation

subServices.name: GST Return – Small & Large

subServices.name: GST LUT Bond

subServices.name: TDS - Salary Return

subServices.name: PTRC Payment & Return

subServices.name: PTEC Payment

subServices.name: PF Payment & Return

subServices.name: ESIC Payment & Return
subServices.data: Prepare challans and upload ESIC returns for insured employees, ensuring timely compliance.

subServices.name: MLWF Payment

name: Other Services
